title: statement parsing (bytes)
property: tryParseStatement never throws and accepts exactly the byte strings that are strict UTF-8, valid JSON, a valid statement (of the expected type, if given) and byte-identical to the canonical encoding (so duplicate keys, whitespace, -0, other number spellings, \u escapes, BOM and invalid UTF-8 are rejected); parseStatement throws StatementError exactly when tryParseStatement rejects

slow.basis: max(1000 ms, 100 x median call time of the first 200 cases); not a timing result

callTimeMs.note: time of the call(s) under test, for the slow-input detector only; not a timing result (untimed series, no quiet-machine protocol)
